assets.label: 정규전
assets.subject: A compact fan of exactly three ivory playing cards with deep teal backs and one coral diamond face, fine muted brass corner ornaments, a small teal ribbon tucked behind. Clearly a three-round card match.

assets.label: 단기전
assets.subject: A small charming hourglass with ivory frame, coral red end caps, clear glass and turquoise sand, a tiny brass clock winding knob. Clear strong hourglass silhouette.

assets.label: 친구대전
assets.subject: Two ivory playing cards leaning toward one another, one coral heart and one turquoise club, tied at the base by a short soft blue ribbon. Friendly versus card match, compact symmetrical composition.

assets.label: AI대전
assets.subject: A cute small ivory and muted teal clockwork robot head with two friendly blue eyes and short antenna, peeking over a single ivory playing card showing a coral diamond. Compact friendly training opponent, not futuristic or neon.

assets.label: 캐릭터
assets.subject: Two overlapping small portrait cards in ivory and pale blue frames: front card shows a tiny chibi silver-haired fantasy girl face with amber eyes, back card shows a tiny purple-haired fantasy girl face. These are generic character collection portraits, not a full standing character.

assets.label: 상점
assets.subject: A small open teal leather coin purse with a cream flap and muted brass clasp, three chunky warm gold coins partly visible, a tiny coral ribbon. Richly illustrated shop object, no currency symbols.

assets.label: 친구
assets.subject: Two overlapping puffy speech bubbles as tangible painted tokens, one pale cyan with a small friendly ivory cat face and the second coral with a small friendly ivory bunny face, a little cream heart between them. Readable friendly social menu symbol.

assets.label: 전적
assets.subject: An open ivory match record notebook with a teal cover, tiny orderly blue tally marks (not readable words), a small brass laurel medal and coral bookmark ribbon along the lower corner. Compact game history object.

assets.label: 게임 방법
assets.subject: A slightly open thick ivory rule book with a pale teal hard cover and brass corner protectors, one ivory playing card with a coral heart tucked into the pages and a coral ribbon bookmark. Readable book silhouette.
